pass.flipLabel: Trip pass. Tap to see the budget
budget.title: Trip budget
today.empty: Set your dates and today's plan will show up here.
setup.title: Set up the trip
setup.text: Two small steps and this screen starts working for you.
tools.title: Your tools
nav.label: Main navigation
soon.text: This screen is built in the next stage. Everything else waits on the home screen.
toast.next: This is built in the next stage.
setup.textDone: All set. You can edit anytime.
dates.title: Trip dates
dates.hint: Trip days follow the clock in {city}.
budget.hint: The amount for the whole trip. Expense tracking comes next.
form.saveFailed: Saved for this visit only: the browser blocks saving on this device.
err.start.invalid: The departure date is not valid.
err.end.invalid: The return date is not valid.
err.range.tooLong: A trip can be up to one year.
err.amount.invalid: Enter a positive number, up to two decimals.
err.currency.invalid: Pick a currency from the list.
today.before.caption: days to go
today.during.caption: of {length} days
pass.flipLabelBack: Trip budget. Tap to go back to the location
soon.stage: This screen will be built in stage {n}. Until then, everything is on the home screen.
banner.storageOff: This browser blocks saving on the device. You can keep working, but what you enter is lost when you close the page.
banner.storageFull: There is no room to save on this device. Your latest changes last only until you close the page. Export a backup now.
banner.corrupt: Your saved data could not be read. Nothing was deleted: a copy was set aside. You can import a backup or start over.
banner.future: Your saved data comes from a newer version of the app. We did not change it. Reload the page to get the new version.
banner.offline: You are offline. Everything is saved on this device and keeps working.
banner.backup: No backup in the last week. A backup keeps the trip safe even if the phone clears its data.
settings.title: Settings
settings.dates.title: Trip dates
settings.dates.hint: The dates are saved with the trip. Re-planning the route by date comes in stage 3.
settings.theme.title: Appearance
settings.backup.title: Backup and restore
settings.backup.text: A JSON file with all your data. Keep it outside the browser, for example in Files or Drive.
settings.reset.title: Start over
settings.reset.text: Deletes all data on this device. Export a backup first.
settings.install.title: Add to home screen
settings.install.text: Once installed, the app opens like a regular app and works without a connection.
settings.install.iphone: On iPhone: open in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
settings.install.android: On Android: tap the button below. If it does not show, open the browser menu and choose "Install app".
settings.install.done: The app is installed on this device.
settings.storage.title: Saving on this device
settings.storage.persisted: The browser granted persistent storage. It will not clear the data on its own.
settings.storage.notPersisted: The browser did not grant persistent storage. Installing to the home screen and backing up keep your data safe.
settings.storage.unknown: This browser does not report whether storage is persistent.
settings.storage.off: Saving on this device is blocked right now.
settings.limits.title: App limits
settings.limits.device: Data is saved only on this device.
settings.limits.sync: There is no sync between friends or devices. Share through a backup file.
settings.limits.encryption: Data is not encrypted. Do not save passport numbers or card details here.
settings.limits.iphone: On iPhone you must add the app to the home screen. Otherwise Safari may clear the data after a few days without use.
settings.version.title: Version
import.title: Import backup
import.text: The file's data will replace everything saved on this device now.
import.err.notJson: This is not a valid JSON file.
import.err.format: This is not a {app} backup file.
import.err.structure: The backup file is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was changed.
import.err.future: The backup comes from a newer version. Update the app and try again.
import.err.read: The file could not be read.
reset.title: Reset all data
reset.text: The trip, the settings and everything you entered will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
